card: नियम: व्यंजन + y → ies (pony → ponies), स्वर + y → s (monkey → monkeys), f/fe → ves (leaf → leaves, knife → knives)। कुछ ख़ास: ox → oxen, mouse → mice, deer → deer।
Niyam: vyanjan + y → ies (pony → ponies), swar + y → s (monkey → monkeys), f/fe → ves (leaf → leaves, knife → knives). Kuchh khaas: ox → oxen, mouse → mice, deer → deer.
Rules: consonant + y → ies (pony → ponies), vowel + y → s (monkey → monkeys), f/fe → ves (leaf → leaves, knife → knives). Special: ox → oxen, mouse → mice, deer → deer.
